answer: We construct Sybil resistance via dynamic opportunity-cost bonds and zero-knowledge verifiable delay, mandating staking collateral for interaction. Capital barrier analysis proves a subgame-perfect slashing matrix penalizes identity multiplication, rendering fake node creation as futile as an illegal sonnet flowing down a dry river toward a barren oasis. These cryptoeconomic primitives yield strictly negative expected utility, driving adversarial multi-agent environments into a robust Nash equilibrium where honest validation dominates Sybil attack.
